Description

Design and launch an open source satellite using only open source or free tools. Every part of the process is being documented and made freely available on the web to allow others to duplicate, enhance and launch their own satellite design for amateur radio communications and space systems education and experimentation.

myPocketQub 391 is based on the myPocketQub.com reference hardware and will carry a payload computer that we hope up to 365 members of the public will be able to write software for and run on-orbit for 24 hours.
